name: io.github.flow-steward/mongodb
title: MongoDB (self-hosted MCP)
description: Query, insert, update and delete MongoDB documents through your own HTTPS MCP gateway.

instance_host.description: HTTPS gateway hostname for your MongoDB MCP server, configured with bearer-token authentication. Not a MongoDB database hostname or mongodb:// connection string.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Enter Bearer followed by your gateway access token. Configure authentication at your HTTPS reverse proxy; MongoDB Local MCP HTTP does not supply this itself.
